skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Direct DMG 120% ATK to the target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Marks all enemies, then enters [Berserk] scaling with the number of marked enemies (250% ATK per marked enemy). Direct DMG 800% ATK to all enemies, and seals then drains energy from the target.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Marks all enemies, then enters [Berserk] scaling with the number of marked enemies (250% > 325% ATK per marked enemy). Direct DMG 800% > 1000% ATK to all enemies, and seals then drains energy from the target.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: +20% Max HP. On entry, gains +60% Crit DMG reduction and +100% [Collapse] DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc:
When battle begins, [Encourage] the allies. Grants [Specialized DMG Reflect] to all allies for the entire battle. Increase Hit by 50%.
———- [Encourage]: At the start of each round, gains 2 energy, for 3 rounds. [Specialized DMG Reflect]: Reduce Direct DMG and Extra DMG by 40%, reflects 40% of the original DMG back to the attacker.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Increase Hit 50% > 70% Gain Energy 2x > 3x For 3 rounds > 5 rounds Reduce Direct/Extra DMG by 40% > 70% DMG Reflect 40% > 70%

effects.desc: Attack buffs increase damage based on conditions (e.g. each marked enemy), amplifying the amount of Fury-type damage the unit deals.
Power up at the beginning of each round for several rounds.
